commandDescription: Pour a round of rum to restore crew morale and burst confetti
protestPhrases: The crew are banging empty rum casks in protest
Mutiny whispers are drifting across the foredeck
Hands refuse to haul another sheet without a tot of rum
The helmsman keeps grumbling about short rations
retryPhrases: Sudden squall forced a tack; crew spirits dipped
Reef ahead meant hauling back; the deckhands scowled
failedPhrases: Took a broadside on the last run; morale took a heavy hit
The last chart led straight into a storm; hands are rattled
cancelledPhrases: Called off the chase mid-run; the crew look puzzled
Dropped anchor mid-maneuver; sailors let out a sigh
rumPhrases: Rum for all hands! The crew are roaring back to life!
Cheers, Captain! Every sheet is flying faster than lightning!
